t: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
s: We introduce VFlash, a method for fast, accurate visual planning through Flash Primitive Decoding.

t: SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training

t: SAFTAC: Simulation-Augmented Fine-Tuning of Open-Source LLMs for Analog Circuit Design
s: Using this dataset, we present SAFTAC, a simulation-augmented fine-tuning framework that trains LLMs to generate and revise analog circuit design.

t: FastAFD: When Does Attention-FFN Disaggregation Pay on Rack-Scale NVLink?
s: We build and tune FastAFD, an AFD engine for GB200 NVL72 that overlaps the MoE of one microbatch with the attention of the other, and compare it against the best vLLM wide EP setting.

t: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
s: We introduce FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark with 56 tasks made by 42 physicists based on their own research, covering nine domains across theoretical, computational, and experimental physics.
